summary: Checks whether a value is **not** a slide id.
description: `nonValidSlideId(value)` is the same test as `!isValidSlideId(value)`, written so that a guard clause reads as a sentence rather than as a negation.
Letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, at least one of them. Slide ids are short — `p1` is a perfectly ordinary one — so no minimum length is imposed.
`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).
returns: `true` when the value is not a slide id; otherwise `false`.

examples.title: What passes and what does not
examples.body:
```javascript
nonValidSlideId("has space"); // => true
nonValidSlideId(""); // => true
nonValidSlideId("p1"); // => false
nonValidSlideId("SLIDES_api123"); // => false
```
